decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component that can be used across the firm's heater range, so keeping it costs little and preserves an option on quieter products.
It had its own product page at launch, and plaque heaters are long-lived industrial products whose value is not yet clear after only a few years, so the low-cost option stays open.
There is no evidence that it has failed, and the 2022 energy situation makes demand for efficient hall heating uncertain but potentially attractive, so waiting is worth more than dropping.
Tube heaters are a core product category and keeping this variant in the catalogue costs little, although it overlaps with Product F.
As the standard plaque model with its own page, it likely serves as a volume product and should be kept while market uncertainty resolves.
It overlaps with Product D, so it carries a somewhat higher risk of being consolidated, but there is no negative evidence yet to justify giving up the option.
